newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-ZICKLER DOUBTFUL FOR BAYERN OPENER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZICKLER DOUBTFUL FOR BAYERN OPENER.

text.p: Bayern Munich striker Alexander Zickler faces minor surgery on his left knee on Friday, the German champions said on Thursday.

Zickler was hurt in a clash with defensive midfielder Dietmar Hamann in training on Wednesday. He should be back in action next week but will probably not be fully fit when Bayern start the defence of their Bundesliga title against Kaiserslautern on August 2.
